artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering all 5 phases, deviations, and independently re-verified verification results.

completion_data.completion_summary: Completed the final phase (Phase 5, verification sweep) of the docs truth sweep, independently re-verifying all claims rather than trusting the prior uncommitted state: check-extension-docs.sh, generate-context-line-counts.sh --check, a dangling-reference grep sweep, and index-entries.json resolution all pass. verify-deploy.sh shows 21/22 gates passing, with the sole failure confirmed pre-existing (test-index-entries-schema.sh fixture assertion, untouched by this task). Committed the remaining uncommitted Phase 5 work (plan checkboxes plus the core/manifest.json provides.docs fix) and wrote the implementation summary.

memory_candidates.content: When a Phase 5 (or final) verification phase's gate run turns up a pre-existing failure unrelated to the current task's diff, confirm it with git log on the failing test file AND the code path it exercises (e.g. check-extension-docs.sh's Rule U logic) before writing it off -- if neither was touched by any commit belonging to the current task, and the test exercises a synthetic/fixture-based scenario rather than real repo content, that is sufficient proof of pre-existing/unrelated status without needing to check out prior commits.

Resuming an implementer dispatch after a prior run left work uncommitted: check `git status --porcelain` and `git diff` on the plan file FIRST -- a plan showing all phases [COMPLETED] with an uncommitted diff (rather than a stale [NOT STARTED] heading) means a prior agent run did the work but was interrupted before committing/writing final metadata. Don't re-do the work; independently re-verify the claims, then commit and close out.
